I’m joining my colleagues to call on CMS to reverse course and support full access to new, emerging Alzheimer’s treatments through Medicare. These groundbreaking medications will save lives and should not be limited to a chosen few!
https://t.co/9c5TThixh0

I was proud to support $105,000 to improve pediatric cancer treatment at Nemours Hospital, $1.2 million for @JTAFLA to create a solar-powered fast-charging station for the transit agency’s electric bus fleet, (2/5)

$705,000 for @UFHealthJax to better deliver comprehensive health care services for uninsured patients, $200,000 for the Army Corps of Engineers to assess flood mitigation options in St. Augustine, (3/5)

The thought of your child receiving a life-threatening health diagnosis is unimaginable. When the unthinkable does happen, families know they can count on the incredible team at Nemours Children’s Health in Northeast Florida.

I’m proud to support them on House Appropriations.

High-THC cannabis use has been shown to increase schizophrenia. "...we see links with schizophrenia, poorer cognitive function, substance use disorders, etc," Hjorthøj wrote.

https://t.co/mXBuxR9Vac

To assist with Hurricane Ian recovery, @FEMA’s National Flood Insurance Program announced that the period for submitting claims has been extended and that property owners with lapsed policies can still receive coverage for Ian damage.
                
https://t.co/UHg6tSgTaM

As we prepare to feel the full effects of #TropicalStormNicole in the coming days, I encourage you to follow local guidelines, exercise caution, and shelter in place as directed. For updates, visit:  https://t.co/mBRCV5MkeG

Seniors should not have to jump through hoops to schedule basic tests & vaccinations. That is why I have cosponsored H.R. 7213, which would increase access for seniors by allowing them to use their Medicare benefits at pharmacies for common tests, treatments, & vaccinations.

Over the past 2 years, our healthcare workers have been forced to choose between individual freedom & providing life-saving treatment to patients. I was proud to cosponsor the Freedom for Healthcare Workers Act & will continue protecting Americans’ rights.
I am committed to improving our mental health care system, to keeping firearms out of the hands of those who should not have them, and to making our communities across this nation safer.

The Everglades has a direct impact on the health of FL & our waterways. This is an exciting step forward in Everglades restoration, delivering 360,000 acre-feet of clean water to the Everglades! I will continue to work on a bipartisan basis to fully fund Everglades restoration.

I'm proud to join my colleagues in reintroducing the bipartisan Ellie's Law this Congress. Our bill will support research to improve detection and life-saving treatment for unruptured brain aneurysms. Together, we can catch the signs of brain aneurysms before they occur. https://t.co/nKniyoNtNT

I'm proud to join @RepPaulTonko and our colleagues in creating a pathway for individuals who are released from prison to receive the mental health and addiction support they need. This bipartisan legislation is smart on crime, saves lives, and reduces recidivism.

All Americans benefit from a strong economy. The Limit, Save, Grow Act will stop out-of-control federal spending, grow the economy, & protect Medicare & Social Security.

It's time for @POTUS to respond to @HouseGOP's good-faith effort to avoid default.

https://t.co/vif1wrsowl

I'm proud to join @VernBuchanan in urging HHS to end the COVID-19 vaccine mandate for U.S. healthcare workers when the public health emergency ends next week. All other draconian COVID-19 vaccine requirements have been lifted - it's time to do the same for those in healthcare. https://t.co/ggR1Uc7p4S

As a former sheriff, I saw firsthand how better access to mental health care creates safer communities. This #MentalHealthMonth, we recognize the impact mental health care systems have on those affected by mental illness & their role in building safer and stronger communities. https://t.co/FDzethezUI

My colleagues and I on @HouseAppropsGOP Military Construction-VA Subcommittee just voted to fully fund the president's VA budget request, prioritizing veterans' health care programs & VA benefits. I will continue to deliver on my promise to care for our nation’s veterans.

I enjoyed discussing employment opportunities for formerly incarcerated individuals with @jpmorgan CEO Jamie Dimon. Employment empowers returning individuals to secure stable housing and healthcare and achieve success. That’s not being soft on crime, that’s being smart on crime!

This #MensHealthMonth, I am proud to cosponsor H.R. 1826, the PSA Screening for HIM Act, which increases coverage for preventative prostate cancer screenings for men with a family history. Together, we can detect early & save lives. https://t.co/hiQ3iHoV4J

President Trump allowed employers to offer employees affordable & expanded health insurance options. I am proud to vote for H.R. 3799, which codifies this rule to expand health insurance access for small businesses and their employees. https://t.co/JMxiXsGmyz

Thank you SCOTUS! President Biden and the Democrats would have us take adequate housing, food, healthcare and education from America’s hardworking poor and middle class to pay off student loans for the wealthy. (1/2)

I am proud to join @repgusbilirakis and support H.R. 2365, legislation aimed at creating an advisory council of federal agencies, caregivers, patients, and medical experts to evaluate all federal Parkinson's programs & write a national plan to prevent and cure Parkinson's. https://t.co/rPrwGMXeBv

This #NationalRecoveryMonth, I’m proud to join my colleagues on the Bipartisan Second Chance Task Force to cosponsor the Reentry Act, which helps states restore healthcare access, including addiction & mental health care, to incarcerated individuals before they reenter society. https://t.co/ulLJNXn2mh

This #SuicidePreventionMonth, we continue our efforts to raise awareness about the symptoms of mental illness & support those who are struggling. If you or someone you know needs assistance, DIAL 988 to reach the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline. #YouAreNotAlone https://t.co/0u58DPqIRa

The PACT Act, which I supported, makes millions of toxic-exposed veterans newly eligible for expanded VA benefits. Through 9/30, a special enrollment period allows post-9/11 combat veterans to enroll directly in VA health care. To learn more, please visit: https://t.co/yAxLhL7bho https://t.co/ojnLrFGeDy
